name: Bilhan
title: Descendant of Seir the Horite
summary: Bilhan is a biblical figure mentioned in two different contexts: as the son of Eser, a descendant of Seir the Horite in the land of Edom, and as the son of Jediel from the tribe of Benjamin. As a descendant of Seir, he represents the original inhabitants of the land of Edom before Esau's descendants took over the area.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Bilhan is listed as a son of Eser, one of Seir's sons, among the patriarchs of the Horites in the land of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Chieftains of the Horites
keyEvents.description: Bilhan's father Eser is mentioned among the chieftains of the Horites in the land of Seir, indicating the family's leadership position.

keyEvents.title: Seir's Descendants in Edom
keyEvents.description: Seir's sons and their descendants, including Bilhan, are noted as the original inhabitants of the land before Esau's descendants settled there.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Bilhan is again listed as a son of Eser in the great genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place in Seir's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Bilhan of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Another Bilhan is mentioned as a son of Jediael, son of Benjamin, and is the ancestor of a large warrior clan numbering 17,200 men.
